summary.zh: 界面优化：登录页布局重排更美观，自部署弹窗不再被输入法遮挡，设置页账号栏新增多账号切换入口。
summary.en: UI polish: the login page layout is redesigned, the self-hosted sheet no longer hides behind the keyboard, and the Settings account section gains a multi-account switcher.

items.zh: 登录页重排：固定顶部区域、内容顶部对齐、自部署区块用分隔线独立成组
items.en: Login page redesigned: fixed header block, top-aligned content, self-hosted section as its own group with a divider

items.zh: 修复自部署 OAuth 弹窗被输入法遮挡、无法滚动到输入框的问题
items.en: Fixed the self-hosted OAuth sheet being covered by the keyboard with fields unreachable

items.zh: 设置页账号栏新增多账号切换：点头像行切换当前账号，支持移除未激活账号
items.en: New multi-account switcher in Settings: tap a row to switch, remove inactive accounts
